### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://womentecheurope.eu/active-calls/
Women TechEU is designed to support women-led early-stage deep tech startups from Europe. Selected startups will receive €75,000 in non-dilutive funding, together with a personalised business development programme including mentoring, coaching and training. Applicants must first complete the Eligibility Strand to verify that they meet the programme's participation requirements.

### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://womentecheurope.eu/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/WomenTechEU_Guidelines_Eligibility-V8.0.pdf
With 75k€ grant (non-diluting finance)
a total of €12 million in non-dilutive funding through an open call
six-month support programme
registered for a minimum of six months and a maximum of five years at the time of the eligibility cut-off date
the applicant must be established in an EU Member State and their outermost regions or Horizon Europe Associated Country
The founder or co-founder must be the woman
must also currently hold a top management position (CEO, CTO, CSO or equivalent)
It will be also required that women hold at least 25% of the shares in the CAP table
Using technology and being a deep tech company are very different concepts.
currently in a development stage between TRL4 and TRL6 (both inclusive)
neither the full application or any of its parts have benefited from previous Women TechEU initiatives
the category of SMEs comprises enterprises which employ fewer than 250 people
annual turnover not exceeding EUR 50 million
has raised less than EUR 1 million in equity

### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/competitive-calls-cs/48106227
Women TechEU 2 EIC is an EU-funded project designed to support women-led early-stage deep tech startups from Europe. Through the programme, selected startups will receive €75,000 in non-dilutive funding, together with a personalised business development programme including mentoring, coaching and training.
Cifras anteriores en notación española (la fuente usa la coma inglesa como separador de miles): 75.000 €
